result.description: The Aster Loom 27Q is a fictional 27-inch productivity monitor built for illustration, office layouts, and color-aware document work. It features a 2560 x 1440 IPS panel, 95% DCI-P3 coverage, a 120 Hz refresh rate, and USB-C input with 65W power delivery. A matte anti-glare coating and adjustable stand support long desktop sessions, while the integrated hub includes dual USB-A ports and a headphone jack.
